cohort: 53 women diagnosed with fetal growth restriction based on ultrasound examination
finding: Gestational age at diagnosis and at delivery, and birth weight are the most important prognostic factors related to adverse outcomes in the management of fetal growth restriction.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery for fetuses with growth restriction.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis: 28.5 weeks (complications group) vs. 32.15 weeks (no complications group), mean gestational age at delivery: 29.2 weeks (complications group) vs. 32.8 weeks (no complications group)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 774g (complications group) vs. 1416g (no complications group)
